meta.title: Edge Anomaly Detection SQLite Database Schema (events.db)

cards.title: Physical SQLite WAL Schema (server/db.py)
items: Exactly 3 physical tables in events.db: events, anomalies, and frame_metrics (no foreign keys)
Device registry (pipeline.devices) is maintained in-memory as DeviceState dataclasses, not a SQL table
Configured with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 per thread-local connection

cards.title: Write Paths & Concurrency
items: events and anomalies are inserted inside pipeline.ingest_detections() under pipeline.ingest_lock
frame_metrics is inserted by server/worker.py after frame annotation outside ingest_lock
Timestamp B-tree indexes (idx_events_ts, idx_anomalies_ts, idx_metrics_ts) accelerate rolling window queries

cards.title: Rolling Aggregations in db.stats()
items: Computes processed FPS over the last 10s of frame_metrics (COUNT(*) / 10.0)
Computes average JPEG KB, inference_ms, and e2e_ms over the last 60s of frame_metrics
Groups total anomaly counts by rule (occupancy_spike, unexpected_object, object_dwell)
